question_answered: What marks and duration does the official notification prescribe?
only_valid_source: The official TGPRB / TSLPRB notification for this recruitment
status_meaning: Every entry is VERIFIED from the retrieved notification (DOC-OFF-002, pages 19/20/23/24/42/43/44). The notification sets per-paper totals and subject question counts, but publishes no per-topic marks distribution, so no topic weightage exists to record.
base_document: DOC-OFF-002 (Rc No. 225 / Rect. / Rect-1 / 2026 dated 29-07-2026). The supplementary notification (DOC-OFF-003) amends age only; it does not alter marks, duration, paper structure, or syllabus.
reading_basis: WHITESPACE_NORMALISED_VERBATIM from the committed page-marked extraction artefact research/extractions/official/DOC-OFF-002-si-notification-pages.txt, pages 19, 20, 23, 24, 42, 43, 44; each quote re-checked for whitespace-normalised containment. Every entry cites a RETRIEVED document.
rules: Only what the notification itself states. Per-paper totals if that is all it gives.
Topic-wise marks are T1_OFFICIAL only if the notification prints a topic-wise distribution. Otherwise no official topic weightage exists, and this file records that absence rather than filling it.
Never merge a figure from this file with a figure from historical_observed.json or estimated_priority.json into a single displayed number.
official_topic_weightage_note: The notification prints only per-paper totals and per-subject question counts. For the Preliminary Written Test the two subjects are single lines and the General Studies list of six items carries no per-item marks; for the Final Written Examination Paper IV the General Studies list of seven items likewise carries no per-item marks. The finest official granularity is the per-subject question count, not a topic-wise marks distribution. There is therefore no official topic-wise weightage to record; null has been replaced by a definite false because the documents have now been read.
